messages:
maria-nguyen: Heads-up — planning a synthetic GPU saturation run in eu-west tomorrow 02:00 UTC to validate the new admission-control thresholds after the autoscaler tweak. Will ramp and KV-cache warmup. /cc @ajay-patel @selina-wu

ajay-patel: SGTM. post the floodtester config? want to ensure we don't blast shared on-prem nodes.

maria-nguyen: Config draft:
```
floodtester --targets=eu-west --pool=redwood-prod-p1 --qps=6000 --ramp=600 --duration=1800 --kv-warmup=300
```
Will run a --dry-run first to verify connectivity.

selina-wu: Please add a hard cap: `--max-inflight=1200` and an abort rule if 5xx rate > 3% for 3m. Also slice by model-family so heavy models don't skew admission behaviour.

maria-nguyen: Added abort cond: `if (5xx_rate >= 0.03 && sustained(180s)) abort` — will wire an alert webhook to auto-stop.

infra-bot: Scheduled job created: floodtester/1823456000-run in staging-ops (id ftr-9082). Notifying #eng-sre for watch.

samir-khan: Quick cost sanity check: 6k QPS * 1800s * ~30 tokens/request => 324M tokens. At $0.0004/token that was ~$130k — sounds off, re-run calc?

ajay-patel: Yeah numbers looked high. Let's be conservative: drop to qps=3000 and duration=1200 to save $$ for initial run.

maria-nguyen: Updated plan: `--qps=3000 --duration=1200` with a staged ramp 300 -> 3k over 10m.

selina-wu: Monitoring plan: grafana panel https://grafana.internal/redwood/fleet-backpressure — watch admission_rate, queue_length, avg_latency_p95, reject_rate. I'll set a pager if reject_rate > 0.2% for 10m.

ajay-patel: Also add `--pool-tag=dedicated` so we only hit dedicated capacity pools (avoid shared tenants).

maria-nguyen: Added `--pool-tag=dedicated` and region-scoped to eu-west only for blast-radius control.

samir-khan: I'll be on standby to roll back the admission thresholds if we see cascading fallbacks into lower tiers or cross-region failovers.

maria-nguyen: Thanks all — running at 02:00 UTC. I'll post run id + raw logs once complete. :thumbsup:

ajay-patel: ack — will watch infra metrics and KV cache hit rate.

selina-wu: ack, enabling extra traces for the admission controller for the window. also saved the prompt-set for quality regressions.

maria-nguyen: One last note: dry-run at 01:30 UTC to validate routing and ACLs, no load. If that passes we'll proceed to staged load at 02:00.

ajay-patel: sounds good. ping here when dry-run completes.
